chunks: Abu al-Abbas narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Muslim, from Amir ibn Umayr and Sa'id al-A'raj, all together, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Go to the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) once a year.
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number of times one should visit the grave of Imam Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes an annual minimum for visiting Imam al-Husayn’s shrine, reflecting the Shia emphasis on maintaining a living connection with the Ahl al-Bayt through physical pilgrimage. It underscores the theological significance of Ziyarah not merely as a ritual, but as a continuous act of remembrance and spiritual renewal that binds the community to the legacy of the Imams.
